constructor.factory: SogniFactoryOptions adds proofMetadata?:SogniProofMetadata and submissionProofResolver?:SubmissionProofResolver. Return type ProductionProofProvider & {close():Promise<void>}. Pass both into default createSogniSdkTransport.
constructor.transport: SogniSdkTransportOptions adds same proofMetadata/resolver and now?:()=>number. SogniProviderTransport retains existing SDK methods; optional observeAccount?():Promise<ProviderAccountObservation>,currentSession?():CapturedProviderSession|null preserves existing fake transport shape. Built-in transport implements both.
constructor.closed: No metadata or no synchronous resolver => BUDGET_BLOCKED before actual projects.create. Metadata absent observeAccount also fails closed before getClient/auth. Discover/poll/cancel remain existing behavior. No setters/global registry/SDK client public access.
constructor.injectionCompatibility: Existing bare injected transport mocks may keep offline submit mapping tests without observation methods; provider.observeAccount rejects BUDGET_BLOCKED/currentSession null. They are trusted test doubles, not a guarded real transport. Real/default SDK transport always enforces guard; no flag disables it. Future runtime constructs guarded SDK transport explicitly, never wraps an unguarded arbitrary transport.
constructor.internalSdkType: Extend private SogniSdkClient with optional account?:{me():Promise<{walletAddress?:unknown}>;getSubscriptionStatus():Promise<unknown>}; actual installed SDK exposes both. Optional preserves existing injected poll/discovery fixtures; missing methods => sanitized BUDGET_BLOCKED when observeAccount is requested.

metadata.helper: Export readInstalledSogniProofMetadata():SogniProofMetadata from sogni-provider.ts; synchronous OFFLINE public package-file reads only. Explicit constructor metadata is required for proof path; helper supplies it to future runtime. No credential read or client initialization.
metadata.sdkVersion: Read actual resolved @sogni-ai/sogni-client/package.json version; currently5.49.0 inspected. No assumed/fallback SDK version allowed for proof. Reject missing files, malformed version or supplied version/hash differing from installed evidence with BUDGET_BLOCKED. Custom injected SDK tests explicitly use trusted fixture metadata corresponding to installed evidence.
metadata.adapterVersion: Local new contract literal 'sogni-production-proof-v1'; this is app adapter version, not a vendor/model version. Both roles receive identical value; later semantic adapter changes require new value/review.
metadata.sourceHash: sdkSourceHash=hashCanonicalJson({schemaVersion:1,packageName:'@sogni-ai/sogni-client',sdkVersion,files:[{path,sha256},...]}) with paths sorted lexically and SHA256 exact UTF8/file bytes. Fixed files only: package.json,src/index.ts,src/Account/index.ts,src/Account/subscription.types.ts,src/Projects/index.ts,src/Projects/types/index.ts,dist-esm/index.js,dist-esm/Account/index.js,dist-esm/Projects/index.js,dist/index.js,dist/Account/index.js,dist/Projects/index.js. No appId/role/local file path in manifest hash. Includes actual ESM/CJS code plus inspected SDK source so web/worker share evidence. Missing/changed package files closes proof.
metadata.comparison: At proof-capable client initialization validate supplied metadata against helper result. Final guard receives those exact immutable metadata through ProviderSession. Future C resolver must match session SDK version/source hash/adapterVersion to quote and worker archives; P never substitutes a quote's metadata.

captureProtocol: getClient attempt captures trimmed env.SOGNI_API_KEY ONCE, exactly the string passed to createInstance. Private credentialFingerprint=SHA256 UTF8 captured trimmed key. No env re-read as proof, key logging/serialization, auth backup or fingerprint route exposure.

Allocate fresh local sessionId='sogni-session:'+randomUUID() per successfully initialized cached client attempt; role is existing web/worker/probe; per-role appId existing persistence remains distinct. appId is not account identity and need not be archived.

currentSession() is synchronous/no I/O. null before successful proof-capable initialization, after close/failure, or while invalidated. After initialization may return accountId:null; after successful me returns opaque account ID. It never returns generationId: durable generation belongs to C/S.

observeAccount requires validated metadata; await getClient, record the attempt/epoch and call that client's account.me(), then same client's account.getSubscriptionStatus(). Await neither a second account client nor automatic quote/catalog estimator.

Validate server walletAddress as exactly /^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$/; normalize lowercase. accountId='sogni-account:'+hashCanonicalJson({schemaVersion:1,providerId:'sogni',walletAddress:normalizedAddress}). Raw address exists only transiently; not returned/archived/logged. Supporting non-EVM identifiers requires separate reviewed derivation.

Whitelist subscription {active,status,tier,currentPeriodEnd,providerVersion}. Require active boolean/status nonempty<=80 UTF8; optional tier absent->null or bounded text; unknown returned status/tier preserved literally, never interpreted. currentPeriodEnd absent->null; present requires real ISO UTC ending Z and round-trip-valid date within BudgetUtcMillisSchema. providerVersion absent->null or safe nonnegative integer; never synthesize REST version. Ignore other SDK fields without dumping them. Date parser accepts exactly YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss[.1..3digits]Z, canonicalizes missing/padded milliseconds then compares ISO roundtrip; invalid dates/overflow make subscription:null.

A status request failure or malformed whitelisted status yields subscription:null; authenticated me failure/malformed wallet clears accountId and rejects sanitized BUDGET_BLOCKED. No active/subscription/zero-price inference. Successful current-account observation is not entitlement or authorization.

After awaits require same live epoch/client/session. Sample observedAt from injected now AFTER observations with BudgetUtcMillisSchema; return strict observation. No P TTL/default expiry: C must set finite reviewed expiry when composing S account_session proof.
finalSubmitProtocol: Factory keeps existing capability/request/role mapping and awaits every readAsset; built-in transport.submit then awaits getClient. After this final await require current live client/epoch and authenticated captured session; missing account observation/metadata/resolver => BUDGET_BLOCKED.

Sample at=BudgetUtcMillisSchema.parse(now()); call constructor resolver(snapshot,captured,at). Only literal true passes. false/undefined/Promise/throw => sanitized BUDGET_BLOCKED; no await/resolution of an async return.

After resolver returns true, synchronously recheck unchanged epoch/client/session (resolver can synchronously trigger close). Immediately invoke that exact client's projects.create(submission.parameters), no await/yield between guard and invocation. Existing explicit billingMode stays subscription/tokens; no fallback.

Resolver future C checks durable current generation, pinned account/fingerprint/session, exact archived execution/request hash, proof expiry and matching SDK/source/adapter metadata. P supplies actual captured client facts, not current env assumptions. Changed environment alone does not change cached session/fingerprint; durable generation mismatch still denies.

Actual provider acceptance remains external; P does not reserve/release/settle money. Existing worker submit catch conservatively yields submission_unknown; no worker change or automatic retry is introduced.
resetClose: close increments epoch and clears exposed session/account/clientPromise synchronously, then disposes old client/releases ownership. getClient awaits per-instance closePromise before starting any replacement attempt; this prevents old cleanup releasing a new attempt's locks. Idempotent close; later reinit captures current key/new session.

Any old pending init/observation resolving after epoch change cannot publish session/account state or submit; dispose stale newly created client and reject BUDGET_BLOCKED. Failed init clears only its own attempt, not a newer attempt; preserve existing ownership-release behavior.

An account observation detecting a different account on same client must invalidate old session and reject; require close/recreate/new session before further proof. An unavailable subscription alone keeps authenticated identity but returns null subscription. No auth mutation/reset method is exposed.

Session metadata/account/fingerprint are immutable for lifetime of one authenticated session; raw SDK client never escapes. Cached env mutation does not rebind client. close/recreate or init retry changes session, invalidating old worker proof.
